result.query: Was there a FedEx delivery disruption in Memphis, Tennessee on or around 2026-01-26?

content.summary: Yes—FedEx reported a national service disruption affecting its Memphis hub, and shipments due Monday, January 26, could be delayed.

basis.reasoning: The report quotes FedEx saying contingency plans were active at its Memphis hub and that a national service disruption could delay shipments committed for Monday, January 26.

excerpts: Our top priorities are the safety and well-being of our team members, as well as providing our customers with the highest level of service possible. A National Service Disruption has been issued, and shipments with a delivery commitment of Monday, January 26 may be delayed, with potential delays continuing throughout the week.
citations.title: Carriers issue winter weather service alerts  - Logistics Management
